line.comment: * Zero Hour 1.8 Boarding system
* Terracorp TL
* Nomad Aran
* most Zero Hour boarding features scale to 'weighted Value'. Its just the relative Value of the ship, only with a much a smoother increase for bigger ships.
* Infamy applies to boarding lawful faction ships (commonwealth). Pirates, Yaki, Renegades, OCV, ownerless ships, Phanon, and Kha'ak are excluded.
* Nomad civilian ships use the same infamy penalties as destroying them.
* Boarding an invading Xenon capital ship removes 4 infamy instead, provided that the player did not join the OCV. Xenon M6s grant no infamy forgiveness.
* No infamy is gained for completing a boarding operation against a ship already claimed by the player.
* Boarding Xenon capital ships reduces infamy. Must be an invader to qualify (prevents farming exploits) and must not have joined the OCV.
* Lawful faction ships.
* Nomad Aran flagship.
* TIS dropship.
* Standard lawful TL (e.g., Nomad Mobile Factories).
* All other cases: M6, TM.
* Apply the infamy change.
* Reduce infamy for boarding a Xenon capital ship. Doesn't apply if player joined OCV.
* If no decrease happened, grant Loyalty.
* Add-Ons 1.5.6: Grant Loyalty to the faction that owns this sector.
* If the capture took place in a Xenon, Unknown, Player, or Phanon sector.
* Yaki are intentionally excluded since they operate outside the law.
* Expanded 2.2: Diplomatic consequences for boarding.
* ===== STANDARD REWARDS =====
* Research up to first 25% of the ship blueprint
* Add-Ons 1.13.1: Fix underflow. /4 will be 24.9999%!
* Herobetty: If the player joined the OCV, no research is given.
* Add-Ons 1.4.8a: Fixed research bug if project is already complete. (1.13: Updated message.)
* VALUABLES
* Add-Ons 1.4.14: Now guararanteed but only 20% as much instead of 20% chance.
* Money no longer applies to Xenon, OCV, Kha'ak (never happens), and abandoned ships. For Xenon ships, blue crystals are dropped instead but only if player didn't join the OCV.
* Old: $relVal * 20 + 800 or $relVal * 20 + 900 (average: $relVal * 20 + 850)
* New: ($relVal * 20 + 850) / 5 = $relVal * 4 + 170
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: OCV playthroughs drop red crystals instead of money. Payout is increased by 20% to make up for the lack of passive income generation (only miners and crystal fabs)
* Insane mode reduces the payout by a third. Safer boarding (non-Xenon ships) is affected by difficulty.
* Add-Ons 1.4.20: To compensate for lower rel values of Xenon M7, M1, and TL compared to Xenon M2, their relVals are doubled.
* This effectively doubles the number of crystals that they would otherwise drop. TL is not used by the Xenon but just in case for the future.
* This drop is not affected by difficulty; attrition governs Xenon rewards. The amount is scaled by 10 so that Xenon rewards are 2.5x better than standard rewards.
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: The quantity is now calculated in a new script. Calculate only the value, then pass the value, ware, and ship to the script.
* ===== CONSEQUENCES =====
* The TIS dropship was boarded! Set all variables to null and incur a 2 hour timeout.
* Add-Ons 2.0: TIS delivery and deliverytype are now global metadata.
* Debug only.
* ZH ensure a reputation loss. Vanilla game allows to board someone and still stay friends with him. Maker race is a technical limitation. This can affect Terrans and Yaki unintentionally but its ok.
* $makerRace = $ship-> get maker race
* Herobetty 5.2: Fixed a bug where "reputation loss" message would play if boarding ownerless ships.
* Expanded 2.2: Exclude the Suppression mission giver from boarding reactions.
* Only third-party Commonwealth factions can react to boarding a Commonwealth ship. The former owner is handled separately.
* Exclude the ship's former owner and the mission giver.
* ** Kill off marines ***
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Handle losses before leveling up marines.
* Close quarters fighting on the bridge after ship has already been taken over (ambushes, boobytraps, etc.)
* 1% base percentage of the team to die. This goes on top of all previous vanilla boarding deaths
* Up to 21x as likely to suffer losses based on how crowded the ship bridge was in the end.
* Staying below the maximum allowed number of marines reduces casualties.
* Ship value increases kill chance.
* Add-Ons 1.4.14: Boarded Xenon ships do not increase the kill chance based on ship value.
* For Xenon ships, the price is already paid during the boarding operation combined with the stringent requirement of having 80%+ of your elite (100 fighting) marines at the core.
* +20% losses when boarding M1
* +50% losses when boarding M2
* Herobetty 4.2: Losses are no longer determined by RNG.
* Should no losses occur and the maximum losses is greater than 0, increment the number of "lossless" boarding ops by 1.
* If the kill chance happens to be greater than 10000 (100%), clamp.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Losses no longer kill randomly but rather least skilled first.
* Special case for boarding abandoned ships. If neutral, maximum losses is always 1 and expected losses is always 0.
* Add-Ons 1.4.7: Local variable is now on bailed boardable (M6, TM, M7, M1, M2) ships. This is to cover a special case if the ship was claimed by a tug.
* Default: Expected losses is round(marines * killchance / 10000), up to 60% of the team.
* Get guaranteed losses. If max losses < expected, guaranteed = max. Else, guaranteed = expected.
* Did we have a lossless fight on the bridge and is the maximum greater than 0?
* Get global variables used from previous boarding operation. If it is the very first operation, initialize global variables. These variables are used for lossless boarding operations.
* Did the previous boarding operation determine that we'll lose a man this time? If yes, this operation will kill off one marine and reset the streak to 0.
* We also ensure that the very first lossless operation never loses a man.
* If the guaranteed losses are still 0, increment number of lossless operations.
* Check if rng between 0 to losslessOps results is not 0 or if the lossless streak is 5. If the check passes, set guaranteedMarineDeath to true as a global variable. Else, set to false.
* DEBUG ONLY
* $t = 'Marines Lost: ' + $guaranteedLosses + '; Maximum losses: ' + $maximumLosses + '; Number of lossless operations as of now: ' + $losslessOps
* START [NULL]-> call script 'Joubarbe.Lib.SendMessage' : message=$t log=[FALSE] forceDisplay=[FALSE] delayMs=4000 author=[THIS]
* Kill off marines.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Kill the marines with the least overall skill first.
* Kill the worst overall marines. The marines array is already sorted from worst (head) to best (tail)

line.comment: * **** Level up marines *****
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: For every marine that died post-boarding op, the gained XP for all categories is reduced by 5% per loss.
* Does not apply to recruit marines who level up from fighting.
* Up to 60% of the surviving marines can be killed, so no clamp is needed for the multiplier since losses are already clamped.
* Also reduced RNG bonus from 0-10 to 0-5.
* ** Fighting skill levelup ***
* fresh marines get a huge fighting skill boost after surviving their very first boarding operation, depending on how low their fighting started.
* Add-Ons 1.4.20: firstLevelUp variable is null for newly created marines. Fixed so that fighting actually goes up. The first if-condition was previously being skipped 100% of the time.
* Add-Ons 1.4.21 (comment only): The game engine gives marines a bit of fighting before this script adds fighting.
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Casualty XP penalty does not apply to recruit marines. Only veterans' fighting XP gain and all other categories are affected by the penalty.
* ** DEBUG **
* $t = 'Marine: ' + $marine + '; old fighting: ' + $fighting
* ** END DEBUG **
* veteran marines have a small chance to get a massive skill boost
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Penalize level up if any losses occurred.
* otherwise we still boost the vanilla fighting skill rate a bit
* ** DEBUG **
* $t = $t + '; new fighting: ' + $fighting
* write to player logbook $t
* ** END DEBUG **
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Reduced mech scaling by 20% (mech: 10-30 -> 10-22; avg: 20 -> 16)
* Add-Ons 1.11: Reduced by a further 6.25%, effectively -25% compared to before 1.10.1 (mech: 10-22 -> 10-20; avg: 16 -> 15)
* ** hacking skill levelup ***
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Why randomize from -X to X? NO! Also, fix sort algorithm not sorting by correct indices. For each starts from tail to head!
* Safety clamp. Marines to level should not exceed remaining marines.
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Narrowed range from 1-3 to 2-3.

* Sort the marines from worst hacking (head) to best hacking (tail). Because for each will start at the tail, we need to reverse so that the head (new tail) starts, thus training the worst marines first.
* $hacking.gain.before = $hacking.gain
* ** DEBUG **
* $t = 'old hacking gain: ' + $hacking.gain.before + '; new hacking gain: ' + $hacking.gain + '; new marines size: ' + $marines.s
* write to player logbook $t
* ** END DEBUG **
* ** mechanics skill levelup ***
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Reduced mech scaling by 20% (mech: 340 -> 272)
* Add-Ons 1.11: Reduced by a further 6.25%, effectively -25% compared to before 1.10.1 (mech: 272 -> 255)
* Safety clamp. Marines to level should not exceed remaining marines.
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Narrowed range from 4-8 to 5-7.
* For each traverses from tail to head.
* ** engineering skill levelup ***
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Reduced engineering scaling by 15% (engineering: 380 -> 323)
* Safety clamp. Marines to level should not exceed remaining marines.
* Add-Ons 1.10.1: Narrowed range from 4-10 to 6-8.
* For each traverses from tail to head.
* $t = 'subtype: ' + $subtype + ' / ware: ' + $ware + ' / relVal:' + $relVal + ' / marines.s:' + $marines.s
* write to player logbook $t
* ===== EXTRA REWARDS BASED ON METADATA =====
* Expanded 2.2: Successful boarding is player-caused.
* Expanded 2.2: Shared defeat rewards.
* ZH 1.10: player boarded OCV ships.
* Add-Ons 1.5.6: Now advances the OCV plot if the player acquired OCV ships via boarding instead. (Expanded 2.2: also applies if the previous owner was OCV.)
* NOTE: When this script is called, the ship will have already changed to the new owner (typically the player). However, the $owner argument passed in is the ship's previous owner.
* Add-Ons 1.4.7: Bailed ships (including black market and the free M6 generated at the start of the game) do not need to be copied over - just remove the variable.
* Safety is needed due to an edge case where the boarding op may finish but a tug claimed the ship. If it wasn't claimed during the operation, then Mayhem.Task.Claimeable handles safety.

* Add-Ons 1.4.19: Check if bailed boardable or owner is still neutral race, since all neutral race ships are bailed boardables (retroactive fix, though the bailed boardable flag is good enough for new games).
* Add-Ons 1.14: EquipShip.Safety is now done ONLY in Task.Claimeable.
* Add-Ons 1.4.22: Preserve tunings. CopyShip handles preservation in the other branch.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Copy the ship, as that removes any association with squadrons. This prevents the ship from returning to squadron commands as it's effectively a new ship.

* However, to copy over the followers to the new homebase, we have to temporarily copy the ship with affiliation to the old owner, then copy the followers' homebase over to the new ship, then change ownership back to the new owner.
* Preserve the exact boarding position.
* Destroy the parent ship.
* This is source retirement after boarding, not a second genuine ship destruction.
* Wait until the source no longer occupies its original position.
* Restore the precise position after the original is gone.
* Add-Ons 1.2: Moved to bottom of the code; 1.3: no tutorial on insane.
